messages:
jon_sales: Quick handoff for Albatross (closed). ARR $180k, committed to Dedicated (4 GPUs), wants SSO (Okta), doc ingestion pipeline, and a short enablement for their ML infra team. Renewal in ~11 months but legal flagged data residency concerns. Looping @maria_csm and @sam_se.

maria_csm: Thanks — taking lead on CS. Can you attach the signed order and any SSO notes? Also who will be technical contacts?

jon_sales: Uploaded contract + solution brief to our drive (link: https://redwood.internal/deals/albatross). Primary: Elena V. (Dir, AI Ops). Dev lead: Marco R. They asked for kickoff next Tue.

sam_se: I'll run the technical kickoff. Notes: they want SFTP-based ingestion to their object store and will evaluate smaller quantized models for latency endpoints. Need to confirm Dedicated egress/network constraints for their SOC.

lee_eng: Do we have an existing checklist for Dedicated vs Private network reqs I can reference? I can draft provisioning notes and KMS/HSM constraints.

sam_se: Yes, here's a quick checklist I'll paste in the thread.

sam_se: ```
Pre-kickoff tech checklist:
- Okta SAML metadata + test account
- Network: IP allowlist, VPN or VPC peering options
- Storage: SFTP path, object store bucket, retention policy
- Capacity sizing: 4x A100-equiv, confirm seq len and concurrency
- Models: baseline quantized variant for latency trials
- Security: KMS/HSM details, syslog/siem endpoints
```

maria_csm: CS priorities: 1) schedule 60m kickoff with enablement + tech, 2) spin up a staging Dedicated pool, 3) gather compliance docs for renewal, 4) create a 45-day POC success plan. Assigning owners below.

maria_csm: Owners: Kickoff scheduling - @jon_sales; Tech setup & staging - @sam_se; Provisioning & KMS - @lee_eng; Support SLA & runbook - @ash_support; Success plan + check-ins - me (maria_csm).

ash_support: I'll open a provisioning ticket to track staging and SSO tests. Ticket title: "Albatross 123 - staging Dedicated provisioning".

ops_bot: Created ticket CS-8472: "Albatross 123 - staging Dedicated provisioning"; assigned to ash_support. SLA estimate: 3 business days.

jon_sales: Confirmed kickoff Tue 10am PST with Elena + Marco. Invite sent.

maria_csm: Noted renewal risk: their compliance team may insist on on-prem for data residency. Action: capture compliance requirements during kickoff; if on-prem is required, escalate to enterprise lead.

sam_se: For kickoff I plan two short checks: 1) latency run with the quantized small model, 2) ingestion dry-run with a sanitized sample. Need a sanitized sample dataset or test credentials.

jon_sales: Elena will provide a 2GB sanitized corpus by Monday EOD.

lee_eng: I'll assemble a short KMS/HSM integration note and a provisioning runbook. Will post link in this thread prior to kickoff.

maria_csm: Feedback plan: send a 3-question post-enable survey, maintain a small prompt set for quality monitoring, and escalate to research if regression appears. Owner: maria_csm.

ash_support: Subtasks added to CS-8472: create SSO test account, add IP allowlist, validate sample ingestion, configure log forwarding. ETA 72 hours.

sam_se: Marco asked about RBAC/pinning endpoints per internal teams. Yes — achievable via per-route API keys and console roles. I'll demo during kickoff.

maria_csm: Consolidated next steps (owners):
- Jon: Confirm contract clarifications + attendee list (done)
- Sam: Run tech kickoff + execute tests
- Lee: Provisioning notes & KMS actions
- Ash: Manage provisioning ticket and tasks
- Maria: Create success plan, POC milestones, weekly check-ins
React with :white_check_mark: to accept owners.

jon_sales: \u2705

sam_se: \u2705

lee_eng: \u2705 I'll share the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-albatross before the kickoff.

ash_support: \u2705 CS-8472 updated.

maria_csm: Important: Elena said POC needs to demonstrate ingestion + acceptable latency within 45 days to secure budget. Marking POC timebox as tight. I'll create weekly milestones in the success plan.

jon_sales: One more ask: please document any blockers that might push them to request Private deployment earlier.

maria_csm: Will do. Closing this thread for now; will reopen with kickoff notes and triage updates.

ops_bot: Thread archived in channel 'customer-success' per user request."
